meaningAm: ወደፊት ክብ አደባባይ መኖሩን ያመለክታል። ሹፌሩ ፍጥነቱን ቀንሶ በአደባባይ ውስጥ ላሉ ተሽከርካሪዎች ቅድሚያ መስጠት አለበት።
meaningEn: Indicates a roundabout ahead. Slow down and yield right of way to traffic already circulating within the roundabout.
actionAm: ፍጥነት ይቀንሱ፣ ወደ አደባባዩ ለገቡ ተሽከርካሪዎች ቅድሚያ ይስጡ።
actionEn: Reduce speed, yield to circulating vehicles on your left.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='50,10 90,85 10,85' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10' stroke-linejoin='round'/><circle cx='50' cy='56' r='16' stroke='#1e293b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='10 4'/><polygon points='56,38 62,44 56,50' fill='#1e293b'/><polygon points='44,74 38,68 44,62' fill='#1e293b'/></svg>

meaningAm: ወደፊት የእግረኛ ማቋረጫ (ዜብራ) መኖሩን ያስጠነቅቃል። ለእግረኞች ቅድሚያ ለመስጠት ፍጥነት መቀነስና መዘጋጀት ያስፈልጋል።
meaningEn: Warns of an upcoming marked zebra pedestrian crossing. Drivers must reduce speed and prepare to yield to pedestrians.
actionAm: ፍጥነትን መቀነስ እና እግረኞች ካሉ ሙሉ በሙሉ ቆሞ ቅድሚያ መስጠት።
actionEn: Reduce speed and stop to give priority to pedestrians on the crossing.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='50,10 90,85 10,85' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10' stroke-linejoin='round'/><path d='M30 75 L70 75 M35 70 L65 70 M40 65 L60 65' stroke='#1e293b' stroke-width='3'/><circle cx='50' cy='38' r='5' fill='#1e293b'/><path d='M50 44 L50 56 M44 48 L56 48 M50 56 L44 68 M50 56 L56 68' stroke='#1e293b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>

meaningAm: መንገዱ በተለይ በዝናብ ወቅት የሚያዳልጥ መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃል። ድንገተኛ ፍሬን መያዝ ወይም መሪ ማጠፍ መከልከል አለበት።
meaningEn: Warns that the road surface ahead may be slippery especially during rain. Avoid sudden braking or abrupt steering.
actionAm: የተሽከርካሪ ፍጥነትን መቀነስ እና ድንገተኛ ፍሬን ከመያዝ መቆጠብ።
actionEn: Drive at a reduced steady speed; do not make abrupt steering or braking.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='50,10 90,85 10,85' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10' stroke-linejoin='round'/><rect x='40' y='42' width='20' height='14' rx='3' fill='#1e293b'/><path d='M34 68 C40 64 45 74 52 70 M48 76 C54 72 59 82 66 78' stroke='#1e293b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>

meaningAm: ወደፊት ከፍተኛ ቁልቁለት መኖሩን ያስጠነቅቃል። ጊር ዝቅ በማድረግ የሞተር ፍሬን መጠቀም ይገባል።
meaningEn: Warns of a steep descent ahead. Drivers should engage a lower gear to utilize engine braking.
actionAm: ዝቅተኛ ጊር መጠቀም፤ ፍሬን ያለማቋረጥ አለመጫን (ፍሬን እንዳይግል)።
actionEn: Downshift to a lower gear; avoid continuous braking to prevent brake fade.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='50,10 90,85 10,85' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10' stroke-linejoin='round'/><polygon points='30,75 70,75 70,48' fill='#1e293b'/><text x='35' y='65' fill='#ffffff' font-size='10' font-weight='bold'>10%</text></svg>

meaningAm: በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ተሽከርካሪው መስመሩ ላይ ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆም አለበት። መስቀለኛ መንገዱ ነጻ መሆኑን ካረጋገጡ በኋላ ብቻ መጓዝ ይቻላል።
meaningEn: Vehicles must come to a complete stop before the stop line and yield right-of-way to all crossing traffic before proceeding.
actionAm: ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆም፤ ግራና ቀኝ አይቶ መንገድ ነጻ መሆኑን ካረጋገጡ በኋላ ብቻ ማለፍ።
actionEn: Bring vehicle to complete halt at the stop line; proceed only when clear.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><polygon points='30,10 70,10 90,30 90,70 70,90 30,90 10,70 10,30' fill='#dc2626'/><polygon points='32,14 68,14 86,32 86,68 68,86 32,86 14,68 14,32' fill='#dc2626' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3'/><text x='50' y='58' fill='#ffffff' font-size='22' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>STOP</text></svg>

meaningAm: ከ 50 ኪሎ ሜትር በሰአት በላይ ማሽከርከር በህግ የተከለከለ ነው። በኢትዮጵያ ከተሞች ውስጥ የተለመደ ከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ነው።
meaningEn: Maximum legal speed limit is 50 km/h. Standard urban speed ceiling across Ethiopian cities.
actionEn: Do not exceed 50 km/h under any circumstances.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10'/><text x='50' y='60' fill='#1e293b' font-size='32' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>50</text></svg>

meaningAm: ከፊት ያለውን ተሽከርካሪ ቀድሞ ማለፍ (overtaking) በጥብቅ የተከለከለ መሆኑን ያመለክታል።
meaningEn: Prohibits overtaking or passing other vehicles in this road section due to limited visibility or hazard.
actionAm: ከፊት ያለውን ተሽከርካሪ ሳይቀድሙ በመስመርዎ ላይ ብቻ መከተል።
actionEn: Maintain lane position behind the leading vehicle; do not attempt to pass.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#ffffff' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10'/><rect x='28' y='42' width='18' height='16' rx='3' fill='#dc2626'/><rect x='54' y='42' width='18' height='16' rx='3' fill='#1e293b'/></svg>

meaningAm: በዚህ ቦታ ተሽከርካሪን ለጥቂት ሰከንድም ቢሆን ማቆምም ሆነ ፓርክ ማድረግ የተከለከለ ነው።
meaningEn: Absolute prohibition against stopping or parking vehicles on this section of the roadway.
actionAm: በቦታው ፈጽሞ አለማቆም፤ ተሳፋሪ ለመጫንም ሆነ ለማውረድ አይፈቀድም።
actionEn: Keep moving; no boarding, alighting, or idling allowed.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#2563eb' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='10'/><line x1='22' y1='22' x2='78' y2='78' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='8'/><line x1='78' y1='22' x2='22' y2='78' stroke='#dc2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>

meaningAm: ተሽከርካሪዎች ወደ ቀኝ አቅጣጫ ብቻ መታጠፍ እንዳለባቸው የሚያዝ የግዴታ ምልክት ነው። ቀጥታ መሄድ ወይም ወደ ግራ መታጠፍ የተከለከለ ነው።
meaningEn: Mandatory sign requiring all vehicles to turn right at the intersection.
actionAm: ወደ ቀኝ ብቻ መታጠፍ፤ ቀጥታ ወይም ወደ ግራ አለመሄድ።
actionEn: Execute a right turn; no other direction is permitted.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#2563eb' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M36 65 L36 48 C36 40 42 36 50 36 L64 36 M64 36 L54 26 M64 36 L54 46' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/></svg>

meaningAm: ተሽከርካሪዎች በአደባባይ ዙሪያ በተቀመጠው አቅጣጫ ብቻ መዞር እንዳለባቸው የሚያዝ ምልክት ነው።
meaningEn: Vehicles must follow the circular direction indicated around the roundabout.
actionAm: በአደባባዩ በተመለከተው የቀስት አቅጣጫ ብቻ መዞር።
actionEn: Follow circular path in counter-clockwise direction as indicated.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#2563eb' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='16 8' fill='none'/><polygon points='56,26 64,34 56,40' fill='#ffffff'/><polygon points='44,74 36,66 44,60' fill='#ffffff'/></svg>

meaningAm: በአቅራቢያው ሆስፒታል ወይም የህክምና ተቋም መኖሩን ያሳውቃል። ሹፌሮች ጥሩንባ (ክላክስ) እንዳያሰሙ ይጠበቃል።
meaningEn: Indicates a medical facility or hospital nearby. Horn blowing is strictly prohibited in this vicinity.
actionAm: ጥሩንባ አለማሰማት እና የድምጽ ረብሻ አለመፍጠር።
actionEn: Strictly refrain from using vehicle horn; minimize noise.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='10' width='80' height='80' rx='8' fill='#2563eb' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3'/><rect x='22' y='22' width='56' height='56' rx='4' fill='#ffffff'/><text x='50' y='64' fill='#2563eb' font-size='42' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>H</text></svg>

meaningAm: ተሽከርካሪዎችን በህጋዊ መንገድ ማቆም የሚቻልበት የተፈቀደ የፓርኪንግ ቦታ መኖሩን ያሳያል።
meaningEn: Authorized designated public parking area where vehicles may safely park.
actionAm: በተፈቀደው መስመርና አቅጣጫ መሰረት ተሽከርካሪን በስርዓት ማቆም።
actionEn: Park orderly within the designated pavement markings.
svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='10' y='10' width='80' height='80' rx='8' fill='#2563eb' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3'/><text x='50' y='68' fill='#ffffff' font-size='50' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif'>P</text></svg>
